_comment: Voice roster for the v2 evaluation corpus (corpus/manifest_125.jsonl).
PERSONA-MATCHED SET, chosen 2026-07-20 to remove the cross-language prosody
confound in the original roster. All five share: current tag generation,
masculine, adult, native region, and primary persona 'Neutral/Informational'.
Because a Neutral/Informational voice is low-expressiveness by design, the
f0_semitone_std (monotone) metric is now comparable across languages instead of
being inflated for whichever language got an expressive voice.
Residual, catalog-constrained mismatches (all minor vs the expressiveness gap
we removed): secondary register varies (Conversational for en/de/pt, Customer
Service for es/fr); Rodrigo (pt) is 'Young Adult' while the rest are 'Adult'
(no Adult neutral masculine exists for European Portuguese); Romain (fr) carries
VALIDATE AFTER GENERATION: the tag-based match is a proxy. Once the corpus is
synthesized, confirm f0_semitone_std is in a similar range across the five
languages; a large outlier would mean the tags did not translate to matched
delivery and that voice should be swapped.

es._note: Only Spain-native masculine voice tagged Neutral/Informational in the current generation.

fr._note: Chosen over Leo/Antoine, which are multi-style flagship voices (incl. Character & Animation); Romain's registers are restrained, closer to a pure neutral read.

de._note: One of ~15 matched German options; clean Neutral/Informational Conversational.

pt._note: Kept from the original roster; already Neutral/Informational. European Portuguese (not Brazil).

_previous_roster_deprecated._why: Not persona-matched: Marcus=Confident, Mateo/Mats=Helpful+Attentive, Jules=Enthusiastic+Expressive, spread across two tag generations. Jules inflated the monotone metric for French.
_previous_roster_deprecated._note: The original 7-clip seed corpus on the deployed site still uses these; not worth regenerating. The v2 145-clip run uses the matched set above.
